name: SPACE MARINES: INFILTRATOR SQUAD
description:
Infiltrator Squads are experts in covert operations and are drilled extensively in self-sufficiency and survival skills. Equipped with omni-scramblers that cripple enemy communications, they wreak havoc among their foes before cutting them down with hails of accurate bolt fire.

Go Behind Enemy Lines

This multipart plastic kit builds 10 Infiltrators, disruptive infantry for your Space Marines armies in games of Warhammer 40,000. They are equipped for harassment, and their marksman bolt carbines can reap a deadly toll at mid-range. They excel at throwing even the best-laid enemy plans into disarray.

Gear Up for Battle

The Infiltrators kit allows for lots of customisation – up to 2 miniatures can be built as optional sergeants, and up to 2 can each be equipped with an optional comms array.

The kit includes interchangeable parts:
– 10 helmets (of 5 designs)
– 10 sets of pouches (of 2 designs)
– 20 sets of grenades (of 10 designs)
– 12 honorifics (of 6 designs)

This kit can alternatively be built as an Incursor Squad, an aggressive close-range disruption unit.

Contents:
– 266 plastic components
– 10 Citadel 32mm Round Bases
– 2 Citadel 25mm Bases
– 1 Space Marine Infantry Transfer Sheet
– 1 construction guide

The Space Marine Infantry Transfer Sheet features 757 high-quality waterslide transfers. These include Ultramarines, Imperial Fists, Salamanders, and Raptors Chapter symbols, battlefield role identification, numerals, and more for you to decorate your miniatures.

These miniatures require assembly and are supplied unpainted. We recommend:
– Citadel Tools: Super Fine Detail Cutters
– Warhammer Colour Plastic Glue
– Warhammer Colour paints
